Internal helper: a list of variables with its ranges written out

Source: R/scales.R
dot-jst_expand_ranges.Rd

For a function that reads its variables one by one from the quosures (jdesc() and jfreq() since Session 416; jcorr(), jscreen(), jcomplete(), jdeclare_missing(), jconvert(), jdummy(), jnumeric(), jcount() and jlikert() since Session 426, ruling R90): each range A:B is replaced by the variables from A to B in the data frame's order, each a quosure of its own, so the call reads as if every one had been named (Session 416; the (S413) item). The range is checked as .jst_resolve_varrange() checks it for jalpha(), jsum(), javg(), jmulti() and jplot(): an endpoint that is not a variable takes the not-found stop, and endpoints the wrong way round the stop that gives them reversed. Anything that is not a range passes through untouched, an empty slot among them.

Usage

.jst_expand_ranges(
  quos_list,
  data,
  fn_name,
  data_name = NULL,
  default_used = FALSE
)

Arguments

quos_list

A list of quosures.

data

The data frame.

fn_name

Character(1); the calling function.

data_name

Character(1) or NULL; the data frame's name.

default_used

Logical(1), as .jst_resolve_varrange().

Value

The list, each range written out.
